## Description

/patients/:id: fixed identity banner (allergy chip never collapses; text + icon), verified chart cards: problems (with verification state), medicines (active/stopped with source), allergies, last vitals, key labs with trend mini-charts (HbA1c, BP, weight), last encounters. Start consultation in banner. Tablet two-column layout. The right-hand "AI summary · not reviewed" panel is reserved and hidden by flag until P3.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Allergy state is shown with icon + text (e.g. "Allergy: Penicillin · verified"); "No known allergies" and "Allergies not recorded" are distinct states.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every chart fact shows its provenance tag (Clinician verified, Patient reported, Imported, Synced from HIS) — never an unlabelled value.
- [ ] **AC3.** Opening Patient 360 writes an audit event with purpose.
- [ ] **AC4.** Receptionist role cannot load Patient 360 (403, audited).
- [ ] **AC5.** Layout matches desktop and tablet designs; works at 200 % zoom.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
